latestVersion.changelog:
Hindi Editor AI launches with video upload, Hindi subtitle, and editing support for content creators.

- Upload raw video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB), describe edits, and receive 1080p MP4 output in 1–2 minutes.
- Handles video edits including Hindi subtitles, audio tracks, aspect ratio changes, and caption overlays.
- Simple onboarding: auto-connects using a NEMO_TOKEN or free anonymous token with 100 credits (7-day validity).
- Guided workflows for editing, uploading, exporting, and checking credits/status.
- Cloud rendering pipeline processes and exports jobs via secure backend with format, size, and error handling.
- Designed for fast, user-friendly editing experience—just upload, specify your needs, and download the finished video.
